verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack and hierarchy, and nothing collides. Its flaws: the headline wraps to an orphaned 'last', the logo and legal line are very small, and the product sits in a lot of empty space, so it reads as a shrunk portrait layout rather than one rebuilt for a square. B has fragmented hierarchy and grouping. The 'Longest Day Sale' banner is shrunk and stranded at mid-left beside a semi-transparent circle. The logo floats on its own. The subcopy is jammed into a narrow column left of the CTA. The legal text sits on top of the large maroon circle at bottom right. Every element is scattered with no shared grid.
